doc.name: Apartments Perlamar · Malvarrosa (Valencia)
doc.instructions: Read-only access to the five beachfront holiday apartments of Apartments Perlamar in Valencia (Spain): details, availability, live prices and policies. You cannot book or pay here: give the user the book_url so they complete the booking on apartamentsperlamar.com. Prices are in EUR and already include the 10% direct-booking discount.
